create_CMStochasticIterativeScheduler: create a CMStochasticIterativeScheduler instance with custom sigma_min, sigma_max, and rho parameters for consistency model sampling
run_step_denoising: run one denoising step with the scheduler using model_output, timestep, and sample tensors to get the previous sample
set_timesteps_inference: set the inference timesteps for the scheduler by specifying num_inference_steps or custom timesteps before generation
scale_model_input: scale the model input tensor by the sigma schedule using scale_model_input before calling the step function
add_noise_samples: add noise to original samples at specified timesteps using the scheduler noise schedule for training or img2img
